auskunft.rechte: You have the right to rectification (Art. 16 GDPR), erasure (Art. 17), restriction of processing (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20) and to object (Art. 21). You can also lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority (Art. 77). The data in the “daten” folder is machine-readable (CSV and JSON) and can be transferred to other systems.
auskunft.deckblatt.einleitung: Yes, we process personal data about you. This file contains a copy of that data and the information under Art. 15(1) GDPR.
auskunft.deckblatt.herkunft.uebrige: All other data was recorded by us in the course of our business relationship with you.
auskunft.deckblatt.herkunft.alle: The data was recorded by us in the course of our business relationship with you.
auskunft.uebersicht.genannt.hinweis: These entries only contain a reference to you – other details in them don’t concern you.
auskunft.liesmich.deckblatt: **Deckblatt.pdf** – mandatory information: which data, purposes, origin, recipients, storage period, your rights.
auskunft.liesmich.uebersicht: **Uebersicht.html** – open in a browser: all entries with details and links to the documents, plus the entries in which you are only mentioned. **Uebersicht.csv** – the same as a table.
mail.zip.betreff: Your access request under Art. 15 GDPR
mail.zip.text:
Hello,

you requested information about the data we hold about you (Art. 15 GDPR). You’ll find it attached as a ZIP file.

The file is protected with a password (AES-256). You’ll receive the password another way – for example by phone, text message or letter – not by email. You can open it with, for example, 7-Zip (Windows), Keka (macOS) or WinZip; Windows’ built-in extraction can’t do this.
mail.zip.frist: Please reply by {bis} if anything is missing or you have questions.
mail.link.betreff: Your access request under Art. 15 GDPR, ready to download
mail.link.text:
Hello,

you requested information about the data we hold about you (Art. 15 GDPR). You can download it here until {bis} ({wieOft}):

{link}

To download it you need your access code. You’ll receive it another way – for example by letter, phone or text message – not by email. Please don’t pass the link on.
abruf.unvollstaendig: This link is incomplete. Please open the whole link from the email – it ends with a long string of characters after the #.
abruf.einleitung: You requested information under Art. 15 GDPR about the data stored here. For your security, please enter your access code.
abruf.code.herkunft: You received the code separately from this link – for example by letter, phone or text message.
abruf.code.schreibweise: Upper and lower case, spaces and hyphens don’t matter – “KD-12345” and “kd12345” count as the same.
abruf.download: The download is starting ({groesse}). Store the ZIP file in a safe place.
abruf.passwort: The file is protected with a password. You can open it with, for example, 7-Zip (Windows), Keka (macOS) or WinZip.
abruf.rest: You can download it {wieOft} more with this link.
abruf.aufgebraucht: The link is now used up.
abruf.startet.nicht: If nothing starts, please enter your access code again.
abruf.fehler: That didn’t work just now. Please try again later.
abruf.fehler.verbindung: No connection. Please check your internet connection and try again.
abruf.fehler.falsch: That didn’t work: the link or the access code is wrong, or the link is no longer valid. Check the code (upper and lower case don’t matter). After several wrong entries the link is locked – then contact the sender of the information.
abruf.fehler.ungueltig: This link is no longer valid – it has expired, has been downloaded as often as intended or has been withdrawn. Please contact the sender of the information.
abruf.fehler.zuviele: Too many wrong entries from your connection. Please try again later.
abruf.fehler.ticket: This download has expired. Please enter your access code again.
auskunft.deckblatt.erwaehnungen_one: You are also mentioned in {anzahl} other entry (only the reference to you is stored there):
auskunft.deckblatt.erwaehnungen_other: You are also mentioned in {anzahl} other entries (only the reference to you is stored there):
